import bpy, json, ast, math, struct, zlib
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent
c=bpy.data.collections['Coast_CraftWarehouse']
ns=dict(bpy=bpy,json=json,math=math,struct=struct,zlib=zlib,np=np,Path=Path,Vector=Vector,Matrix=Matrix,root=root,out=root/'assets/coast',c=c)
for key,name in [('wood','Timber'),('rope','Hemp'),('iron','OxidizedIron'),('glass','WindowShade'),('stone','Footing'),('lamp','LampPane')]:
    ns[key]=bpy.data.materials['HarborCraft_'+name]
src=json.loads((root/'source/coast_12_craft_structure.mcp.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['code']
calls=[n for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(src)) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id=='exec']
exec(ast.literal_eval(calls[0].args[0]),ns)
src=json.loads((root/'source/coast_13_craft_props.mcp.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['code']
call=next(n for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(src)) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id=='exec')
body=ast.parse(ast.literal_eval(call.args[0]))
export=next(n for n in body.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='export_asset')
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[export],type_ignores=[]),'MCP_export','exec'),ns)
src=json.loads((root/'source/coast_11_craft_materials.mcp.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['code']
png=next(n for n in ast.parse(src).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='png')
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[png],type_ignores=[]),'MCP_png','exec'),ns)
bpy.app.driver_namespace['harbor_craft']=ns
for o in c.objects:o.hide_set(False);o.hide_render=False
rows=[]
for o in c.objects:
    if o.type=='MESH' and o.name.startswith(('Front siding','Wall stud','Gable fascia','Roof course','Large freight')):
        co=np.asarray([tuple(v.co) for v in o.data.vertices])
        rows.append({'name':o.name,'size':(co.max(axis=0)-co.min(axis=0)).tolist(),'material':o.data.materials[0].name})
print(json.dumps({'session_restored':len(c.objects),'samples':rows[:18]},ensure_ascii=False))
